question: In which year was the first version of the Human Protein Atlas website launched, and on roughly how many antibodies was it based?

result.question: In which year was the first version of the Human Protein Atlas website launched, and on roughly how many antibodies was it based?
result.text: The first version of the Human Protein Atlas website was launched in 2005 and was based on approximately 700 antibodies (specifically, 718 antibodies in version 1.0) [1][2].

result.summary_md:
The first version of the Human Protein Atlas website was launched in 2005 and was based on approximately 700 antibodies (specifically, 718 antibodies in version 1.0) [1][2].
